name: White Box
source:
A young girl lies in a hospital bed. Diagnosed with a terminal illness, all she can do is wait patiently for her life to end. Alone and isolated, she has nobody to turn to in her final months - other than her own doctor. So begins their hopeless love story; doomed from the very start.

[From [url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/65792967730/white-box-download]Ebi-hime's tumblr[/url]]
